generic_sampling_rules.int_primary_key: Sequential integers starting at 1; unique; never NULL; never overwritten by boundary planting.
generic_sampling_rules.int_foreign_key: Sample from parent primary-key pool; for composite-PK child tables, the FK pair is sampled jointly without replacement against the parent's taken set so no INSERT OR IGNORE is dropped; for nullable columns include at least one NULL (share ~1/n) and at least one parent row without children.
generic_sampling_rules.int_range: Uniform integer within the column's range rule; include boundary values and one step on each side where a boundary literal is listed.
generic_sampling_rules.int_quantity: Integer > 0; include 1 and a value near the upper bound.
generic_sampling_rules.float_price: Decimal >= 0 with two fractional digits; include 0.00 and a value near the upper bound.
generic_sampling_rules.text_short: Short ASCII text; include near-variants (case change, one-character substitution, appended suffix) of listed LIKE literals.
generic_sampling_rules.text_date: Date string in the column's observed format; keep any order rule.
generic_sampling_rules.text_enum: Sample from the explicit enum list; include each value at least once.
generic_sampling_rules.null_share: For each nullable column, at least one NULL row per instance; NULL share is 1/n for the generated rows (small, present in every instance). NULL planting is applied AFTER all construction targets (group_sizes, duplicates, ties, boundaries, LIKE variants) so a planted NULL is never overwritten; FK NULL share uses the same 1/n default, not 0.05.
generic_sampling_rules.fresh_value_share: About 20% of text values are fresh near-variants not equal to any observed value.
generic_sampling_rules.composite_pk_unique: For tables with a composite primary key (schedule.Cinema_ID, schedule.Film_ID), sample distinct tuples of the key columns jointly against the taken set (compact PKs + generated) and retry until exactly n distinct tuples are produced; the specified row count is reached by construction and no row is dropped by INSERT OR IGNORE.
generic_sampling_rules.group_size_construction: For columns listed with pattern group_sizes, partition the generated values into groups of size 1, 2, and >= 3 (e.g. by repeating values) so the target distribution is realized; only applied to non-PK columns.
generic_sampling_rules.duplicate_share_construction: For columns listed with pattern duplicates_for_distinct, repeat values so that the duplicate share (distinct count / row count) falls in the target range; only applied to non-PK columns.
generic_sampling_rules.tie_construction: For columns listed with pattern ties_for_order_limit, ensure at least two rows share the top value of the ORDER expression in the listed direction; for aggregate ties (SUM/COUNT over a child table) coordinate the parent values with the child rows so the aggregate is tied at the top rank.
generic_sampling_rules.boundary_construction: For columns listed with pattern comparison_boundary, plant values equal to and one step from the listed boundary literals; applied to PK/FK columns only after PK/FK filling so they are not overwritten.
generic_sampling_rules.like_variant_construction: For columns listed with pattern like_near_variant, plant the exact literal bodies and listed variants without mutation so the LIKE predicates match.
generic_sampling_rules.aggregate_boundary_construction: For columns listed with pattern aggregate_boundary, ensure the group counts (COUNT(*) or COUNT(DISTINCT col)) take the listed values [1,2,3] across the generated groups.

uncertainty: No date-pair order rule exists (single Date column). No calculated column formula is supported by the sample. NULL shares are observed as 0.0 but at least one NULL per nullable column is planted per instruction 10; NULL share is 1/n for all nullable columns including FK columns (not 0.05). NULL planting is applied after all construction targets so it is never overwritten. Composite PK (Cinema_ID, Film_ID) on schedule is sampled jointly without replacement to ensure the specified row count is reached. PK columns (cinema.Cinema_ID, film.Film_ID) are never given duplicate/group-size targets; the earlier duplicate/group-size entries for cinema.Cinema_ID were removed. Film.Film_ID comparison_boundary is applied after the sequential PK fill. Film.Directed_by aggregate ties (SUM/COUNT over schedule) are implemented by coordinating schedule rows with the Directed_by values; schedule.Cinema_ID/Film_ID group_sizes targets are realized by the FK pair sampling while respecting the composite PK uniqueness. aggregate_boundary targets for cinema.Location and cinema.Name are realized by the group-size construction.
